target.statement: Chinese T5 achieves BLEU-4 of 8.41 on the test set of NEWSDIALOGUES

compute.basis: Fine-tuning a 784M-parameter T5 model on 800 dialogues with 2048-token sequences requires GPU memory and time; CPU-only would be prohibitively slow.

blockers: Dataset may not be publicly available; paper says 'Upon acceptance, we will provide...'

title: NewsDialogues: Towards Proactive News Grounded Conversation
